title: Settings › Help & about: long release notes keep the What's new box at 150 px after it measures them, instead of growing to the 480 px ceiling
steps: S1: Mount the real Help & about view with React in jsdom, once with long notes and once with short ones.
expect: S1: long notes leave the box with an inline height of 150px; short notes leave it with no inline height.
fence: jsdom lays nothing out, so the text's height is given; the box in a real browser is measured on dev (cowork.tracy.site, ?settings=help with the bridge stubbed) after merge.

tests: long notes: the box stays at the 150px cap after it measures them
short notes: the box has no fixed height, so it is as tall as its text
